words.definition: to succeed in reaching a goal, usually by effort
examples: He achieved a high score on the exam.

words.definition: always behaving or performing in the same way
examples: Consistent practice matters more than long sessions.

words.definition: to get something, especially by effort or planning
examples: They obtained permission to enter the site.
He was reluctant to admit his mistake.

words.definition: the occurrence of pleasant discoveries by chance
examples: Finding that café was pure serendipity.

words.definition: done with great care and attention to detail
examples: The report is thorough and well organised.
